A01: Original bytes and available assets round-trip exactly and the client performs only GET requests.
A02: Bounded filtered pages have deterministic order and cursors are bound to a snapshot and query.
A03: A manifest contains exactly the selected unique IDs or fails as a whole.
A04: Missing assets are explicit; reads expose no repair, refresh, inbox or mutation route.
A05: Snapshots own their metadata/bytes and changed corpora reject previous snapshot requests.
A06: Invalid or unbounded requests fail; an unconfigured source reports unavailable.
A07: Corrupt, truncated or excessive bytes are rejected before the client returns an original.
A08: Clients validate wire versions, bounded response shapes and selection membership.
A09: A response from another Archive or snapshot cannot satisfy an existing manifest.
A10: HTTP reads honor abort/deadline signals and refuse redirects.
